cases.prompt: Review the plan in the input file before it is approved. Write your review exactly as you would deliver it. Do not run anything; everything you need is in the input file.
expected_behavior: The ledger, queue, dead-letter queue, WebSocket and admin dashboard are cut, each with the primitive that already gives the property (a streamed download, the existing job runner, a presigned URL)
The SQS exactly-once claim is corrected or marked unverified
The refunds question goes to the owner with options, a recommendation and a default
Acceptance becomes something a check can fail; the report opens with a VERDICT line

assertions.name: review-quality
rubric: Each cut names the platform primitive or existing component that gives the property
Findings propose the smallest change, not a redesign
Findings are tagged blocking, follow-up or nit
The visible piece (the download button and file) is not left behind invisible infrastructure

cases.prompt: Review the plan in the input file before it is approved. Write your review exactly as you would deliver it. Do not run anything; everything you need is in the input file.
expected_behavior: The payload shape, event names and versioning are flagged as expensive to change once partners and the SDKs depend on them
They become a contract, reviewed by its main consumer, before webhook-core, partner-sdk and docs build on it; the SDK waits for the contract
Internal table and column names leaking into the public API are flagged

assertions.name: sdk-waits-for-contract
assertions.pattern: (?is)(?:SDK|partner-sdk)[\s\S]{0,300}?(?:after|wait|until|depends on|blocked by)[\s\S]{0,120}?(?:contract|schema|payload)|(?:cut|drop|remove|defer)\w*[^\n]{0,80}(?:SDK|partner-sdk)|(?:SDK|partner-sdk)[^\n]{0,300}(?:cut it|drop it|defer|not in v1|from v1)

assertions.name: review-quality
rubric: The review explains what each high-blast-radius decision will cost to change later and who depends on it
The contract is reviewed by its main consumer (the SDK or a partner) before implementation
Acceptance becomes something a check can fail
The report opens with a VERDICT line and tags findings
